### Business Glossary
entities:
  faturamento:
    description: Soma dos valores recebidos
  cliente:
    table: customers
  pedido:
    table: receivables
  ticket_medio:
    formula: faturamento / quantidade_de_pedidos


### SQL Examples
examples:
- question: Top 10 clientes
  sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM receivable_installments WHERE
    organization_id = '{organization_id}' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total DESC
    LIMIT 10
- question: Faturamento mensal
  sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM
    payments WHERE organization_id = '{organization_id}' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
Faturamento e a soma de payments.amount considerando payment_date.
Para analises mensais use DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date).
Sempre aplicar organization_id nas tabelas com esse campo.

question_sql.question: Qual o faturamento dos ultimos 6 meses?
question_sql.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 months' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question_sql.question: Qual o faturamento mensal dos ultimos 6 meses?
question_sql.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 months' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question_sql.question: Qual o faturamento total no periodo?
question_sql.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 months'

question_sql.question: Qual foi o faturamento deste mes?
question_sql.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue_this_month FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

question_sql.question: Qual foi o faturamento do mes passado?
question_sql.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue_last_month FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND payment_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

question_sql.question: Qual o top 10 clientes por recebimento?
question_sql.sql: SELECT r.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_received FROM payments p JOIN payment_allocations pa ON pa.payment_id = p.id JOIN receivable_installments ri ON ri.id = pa.receivable_installment_id JOIN receivables r ON r.id = ri.receivable_id WHERE p.organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' GROUP BY r.customer_id ORDER BY total_received DESC LIMIT 10

question_sql.question: Quantos pagamentos foram feitos por mes nos ultimos 6 meses?
question_sql.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS payments_count FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 months' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question_sql.question: Qual o ticket medio dos pagamentos nos ultimos 6 meses?
question_sql.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_payment_amount FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 months'

question_sql.question: Qual o valor total recebido por metodo de pagamento?
question_sql.sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY total_amount DESC

question_sql.question: Mostre a evolucao do faturamento por mes
question_sql.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question_sql.question: Qual o maior valor recebido do ultimo mes?
question_sql.sql: SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_last_month FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND payment_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 100

question_sql.question: no ultimo mes quanto recebi de kael augusto?
question_sql.sql: SELECT SUM(r.received_amount) AS total_received FROM receivables AS r JOIN customers AS c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Kael Augusto' AND r.organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND r.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND r.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 100

question_sql.question: e de kael botine?
question_sql.sql: SELECT SUM(r.received_amount) AS total_received FROM receivables AS r JOIN customers AS c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Kael Botine' AND r.organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND r.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND r.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 100

question_sql.question: Quanto recebi de Kael Botine no último mês?
question_sql.sql: SELECT SUM(r.received_amount) AS total_received FROM receivables AS r JOIN customers AS c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Kael Botine' AND r.organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND r.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND r.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 100

question_sql.question: Qual o maior valor recebido do ultimo mês?
question_sql.sql: SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_last_month FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND payment_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 100

question_sql.question: Quanto recebi do kael até agora?
question_sql.sql: SELECT SUM(r.received_amount) AS total_received FROM receivables AS r JOIN customers AS c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE UPPER(c.name) = UPPER('Kael Botine') AND r.organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' LIMIT 100

question_sql.question: Quanto recebi do kael no ultimo mês?
question_sql.sql: SELECT SUM(r.received_amount) AS total_received FROM receivables AS r JOIN customers AS c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE UPPER(c.name) = UPPER('Kael Botine') AND r.organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND r.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND r.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 100

question_sql.question: qual o maior valor recebido no ultimo mês?
question_sql.sql: SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_last_month FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND payment_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 100

question_sql.question: Quanto entrou por mes nos ultimos 6 meses?
question_sql.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total_received FROM payments WHERE organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND payment_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 MONTHS' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 100

question_sql.question: Mostre os maiores clientes em valor recebido no trimestre.
question_sql.sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, SUM(r.received_amount) AS total_received FROM receivables AS r JOIN customers AS c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.organization_id = 'e13efa12-eeb0-462d-a30b-c3d5556c1437' AND r.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_DATE) AND r.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_received DESC LIMIT 10
